shared.label: Off-by-one
shared.description: A loop, index or boundary is one too many or one too few.

shared.label: Wrong condition
shared.description: A comparison or check is wrong: the wrong operator, a missing case, inverted logic.

shared.label: Missing await
shared.description: A promise is used before it resolves, or its errors are never caught.

shared.label: Mutates shared state
shared.description: Changes an input, a default or a module-level value that other code relies on.

shared.label: Missing null/empty check
shared.description: Breaks when a value is null, undefined, missing or empty.

shared.label: Wrong error handling
shared.description: An error is swallowed, reported as success, or thrown where the caller can't handle it.

shared.label: Race condition
shared.description: The result depends on which of two async operations finishes first.

shared.label: Unvalidated input
shared.description: Data from a user or request is trusted without checking it.

shared.label: Injection
shared.description: User data is put into a query, command, path or HTML without escaping.

shared.label: Sensitive data exposed
shared.description: A secret, password, token or private field is logged, returned or stored in the open.

shared.label: Missing permission check
shared.description: Anyone can do something only some users should be allowed to.

shared.label: Repeated work
shared.description: The same expensive work runs again and again, e.g. a lookup or query inside a loop.

shared.label: Sequential awaits
shared.description: Independent async calls wait for each other instead of running together.

shared.label: Unbounded growth
shared.description: A cache, list or listener set grows forever.

shared.label: Unclear name
shared.description: A name doesn't say what the thing is or does, or says something wrong.

shared.label: Does too much
shared.description: A function mixes several jobs and should be split.

shared.label: Duplicated code
shared.description: The same logic is copied instead of shared.

shared.label: Dead code
shared.description: Code that can never run, or a leftover that isn't used.

shared.label: Magic value
shared.description: An unexplained number or string that should be a named constant.

shared.label: Missing test
shared.description: New or changed behaviour has no test.

shared.label: Test checks too little
shared.description: A test runs the code but would still pass if it were wrong.

ts.label: Unsafe type assertion / any
ts.description: `as`, `!` or `any` tells the compiler to trust a value that may not be that type.
